reasons.text: Duplicate check found another claim (ebc26ba7-a962-5bf6-aff2-3d7cd5d1945b) that shares the same label photo as this claim. Under the flag rule, any shared photo, address, email, serial, or payout account routes the claim to flag.
The label photo is legible and shows model SM1979, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The retailer REI is on the sold-at list, the purchase date 2002-04-13 is inside the sale window, and no receipt is required for this claim.
The serial check was skipped, so the serial has not been verified against the recalled ranges. The label reads SN85636551, which matches the typed serial.
